description.value: Mercado Bakery & Panadéria is a Mexican bakery and café on East Hastings Street serving traditional pan dulce — conchas, churros, tamales, and tortas — alongside café de olla and espresso drinks. It is one of several Lower Mainland locations operated by the Originals Mexicano restaurant group, with the Hastings branch positioned near the Hastings & Nanaimo intersection in East Vancouver. Cyclists passing through East Van will find grab-and-go pastries and sandwiches well suited for a quick refuel on the road.
